title: Placement: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: You are given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a given stock on the `i`th day. You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and choosing a different day in the future to sell that stock. Return maximum profit. If no profit can be achieved, return 0.
explanation: Track the lowest historical price encountered so far and record peak difference in O(N) time and O(1) space.
